# occlusal
- relatively equal and symmetrical
	- for buccal and palatal cusps
- shorter central groove
- more supplemental grooves than the [[Maxillary First Premolar]]
- palatal cusp leans more mesially
	- yes
**![](data:image/png;base64,)** right
![[Pasted image 20260331183431.png]]


# crown shape
- oval from occlusal
	- first premolar is hexagonal
# cusps
- 2 cusps
- palatal cusp tilt
# roots
- 1 root
- unlike first premolar with 2

# ridges
- buccal + palatal triangular ridges
- tranverse ridge for comunication


# buccal
- becomes more obtuse and flat
	- relative to other teeth
- mesial slop is shorter than distal slope

left 25
![[Pasted image 20260331182911.png]]

# palatal
- flatter near the cervical line
- palatal and buccal cusps may be ==similar== in height

![[Pasted image 20260331183318.png]]

# mesial
- less arrowhead
	- due to similar cusp heights
- [[#distal]] surface is more defined

![[Pasted image 20260331183326.png]]

# distal
more defined

![[Pasted image 20260331183413.png]]



# root
- single root
- possible developmental groove
	- indicating 2 root canal system
